To locate stationary points, first differentiate f(x) to get f'(x). Then set f'(x)=0 and solve for x. These x-values are candidates for local extrema or saddle points. Finally, use the second derivative test by computing f''(x) at these points: if positive, it's a local minimum; if negative, a local maximum; if zero, further analysis is needed.
